name: Bruchsal (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over blue, charged at the centre with the city arms of Bruchsal (a white cross on blue with a moon in the first quarter).
history: Municipal flag of Bruchsal; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bruchsal arms — white cross on blue
